title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Exodus 7: Aaron's rod before Pharaoh and the river turned to blood.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say Aaron would be to Moses before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet."

questions.text: How old was Moses when he and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

questions.text: Whom did Pharaoh call after Aaron's rod became a serpent?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh called for the wise men and the sorcerers, and the magicians of Egypt did the same with their enchantments.

answers.text: The priests of the temple of On
The wise men and the sorcerers
The elders of the children of Israel

questions.text: What happened to the magicians' rods?
questions.explanation: The magicians' rods became serpents, but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

questions.text: Where was Moses to meet Pharaoh in the morning?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to stand by the river's bank to meet Pharaoh as he went out to the water.

answers.text: At the gate of the palace
On the road to the wilderness

questions.text: What happened to the fish when the river turned to blood?
questions.explanation: The fish in the river died, the river became foul and the Egyptians couldn't drink its water.

questions.text: Where would there be blood throughout Egypt, besides the rivers and pools?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said there would be blood throughout Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.

answers.text: In the bread of the people
In the wells of Goshen only
In vessels of wood and stone

questions.text: What did the magicians of Egypt do after the water turned to blood?
questions.explanation: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments, so Pharaoh's heart was hardened.

answers.text: They admitted they could not do it
They did the same with their enchantments
They begged Pharaoh to let Israel go

questions.text: What did all the Egyptians do because they could not drink the river water?
questions.explanation: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink.

answers.text: They drank only wine from their vineyards
They moved their homes to the sea coast
They dug around the river for water

questions.text: How many days were fulfilled after Yahweh struck the river?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends by saying seven days were fulfilled after Yahweh had struck the river.
